footnote: Most support protocols leave a gap. You buy the hair supplement, then find you also need iron, then collagen, then something for the hormonal side — four purchases, four delivery charges, and no way of knowing whether the amounts add up. Saede is built as the whole thing: the androgen pathway, the stress and cortisol side, the hormonal picture underneath, and the nutrients hair is built from. One system, nothing left for you to work out.
